goal-intelligence.top_gap: The real Anthropic adapter is not the default, was not live-tested, and cannot be reached through a working Gateway/browser path.

goal-management.top_gap: No production app builder binds persistence, clients, and workers; goal-list opportunity status is hard-coded.

discovery-monitoring.top_gap: The Context.dev adapter is instantiated only by a separate probe; no production activation consumer, GoalReader, EvidenceSink, scheduler, or webhook ingress is bound.

data-evidence.top_gap: All non-disputed HTTP submissions are downgraded to unverified, so downstream checked-evidence gates cannot pass.

goal-evaluation.top_gap: No concrete authenticated readers, accepted evaluation HTTP route, or RabbitMQ worker process.

notification.top_gap: No concrete upstream clients, broker process, or approved owner-facing read API.

agent-integration.top_gap: No broker/read API runtime, and local seller_orders differs from the unapproved seller_offers proposal.

gateway.top_gap: Only /health/live exists; none of the seven frozen public paths or service-claim forwarding is implemented.

frontend.top_gap: The production bundle defaults to in-memory mock mode, proposed reads are mock-only, and the local build/E2E commands failed.

p0_blockers.title: Gateway and executable application stack absent
Cross-service workers and authenticated runtime adapters incomplete
Evidence path cannot produce checked reliability
Real Context.dev adapter is not bound to the user workflow
Browser remains mock-first and real frontend path is not green

proposed_tasks.acceptance: One documented command starts the isolated stack; authenticated tests cover all seven frozen public routes; cross-owner and unauthenticated requests fail; services are not directly public.
Restart preserves a confirmed goal, activation publishes once under replay, and goal list/detail use the current-version evaluation projection.

A recorded-provider integration test proves one initial search/scrape and extraction request; duplicate activation and restart do not duplicate work; controlled live smoke preserves request and freshness metadata; demo/prod rejects fixture provenance.
Corroborated fixtures become checked; single, ambiguous, or stale sources remain unverified; conflicts become disputed; provenance and EUR-cent invariants validate.
Broker integration evaluates only the active version, emits once, preserves unknown for missing facts, survives duplicate/restart, and exposes the accepted evaluation read.
Demo/prod startup rejects fixture mode; a controlled smoke returns a valid dynamic draft; timeout or malformed output cannot confirm a goal or switch to fixture.
Production build requires gateway/auth configuration, passes cross-owner browser/API tests, and visibly identifies any explicit mock build.
On documented Node 22, npm ci, typecheck, lint, unit tests, build, and Playwright all exit zero.
Replay produces one owner notification; stale or unchecked opportunities produce none; cross-owner reads fail; restart preserves state.
Replay creates one current owner package; expired, stale, unsafe, or unchecked evidence blocks use; auto_execute remains false; approved schema validates at the Gateway.
Deterministic kg/L/pcs evidence yields correct basket totals including one shipping charge per seller and tax; any unknown item, shipping, tax, or quality blocks verification.
Recorded-provider scenarios A-D pass across broker/service/DB restarts with exactly-once business outcomes under duplicate delivery, redacted diagnostics, and no fake success.
